description: This file defines a LeaveRequestDecorator class in the OrangeHRM system, providing methods to manipulate and retrieve information related to leave requests, such as setting employee and leave type by ID, formatting application date, and fetching the last comment.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for LeaveRequest entities, providing additional methods for setting related entities and fetching formatted data or comments.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a LeaveRequest object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the leave request by employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the LeaveType associated with the leave request by leave type ID.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Returns the date the leave was applied formatted as a string.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent comment associated with the leave request.
